AP-IMPLICIT.rule: No implicit defaults for tenancy, pricing, or ordering; org_id and pricing snapshot MUST be explicit.

AP-KEY-NAMING.rule: Do not use api_actions key naming in contracts; use domain_actions.

AP-PLACEHOLDERS.rule: No TODO/TBD/FIXME/REPLACE_ME tokens in lockable artifacts.

changes: Align ORD with PRICE-SIG-V3 by requiring implementations to persist and expose price_signature_version (from PRICE-1) for checkouts and finalized orders.

Add subscriber entitlement enforcement hooks: create_checkout may accept entitlement_allocations; finalize_checkout MUST enforce SUB-1 eligibility at purchase-finalize time for any subscriber-priced lines.
Support mixed beneficiary scenarios (e.g., 2 subscriber tickets + 2 normal tickets) by allowing per-hold entitlement allocations and requiring entitlement subject binding in the PRICE-SIG-V3 context.
Require SEAT-1.verify_hold_proofs usage: create_checkout and finalize_checkout MUST validate + resolve holds via verify_hold_proofs; ID-only hold fetch is forbidden.
Bump SEAT-1 dependency min_version to 3.0.5 to guarantee verify_hold_proofs exists.
Add ORD_CHECKOUT_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH subcode for commit-time snapshot divergence when resolved hold tuples differ from stored event/occurrence snapshot.
Fix addon dependency terminology to match EVT-2 (Occurrence.occurrence_kind=main; policy fields workshops_require_primary_access and standalone_allowed).
Normalize wording: seat_hold_tokens -> seat_hold_proofs in Order.seat_hold_ids notes and invariants.
No behavioral changes beyond naming alignment; semantic intent remains: holds must be proof-bound; addons require primary access by default.
Occurrence-aware order snapshot: persist event_id + occurrence_ids derived from SEAT-1 holds and EVT-2 occurrences.
Addon dependency enforcement: workshops/sessions/addons require primary access by default (EVT-2 policy-driven).
Rename checkout input seat_hold_tokens -> seat_hold_proofs with hold_signature semantics aligned to SEAT-1.
Align dependency floors with SUB-1 integration: ERR-1 >= 1.3.30, PRICE-1 >= 3.0.12 (PRICE-SIG-V3 gate fix).
Fix bundle manifest version to match contract version (previously 3.0.10 mismatch in manifest for this build).
Bump OBS-1 dependency floor to 2.7.7 to require SUB-1 observation event shapes introduced in the SUB integration patch-set.
No protocol change; dependency tightening only.
Define money-confirmed finalization boundary: order.finalized outbox event SHALL represent paid_confirmed only (no 'paid-ish' states).
Extend ticketing.order.finalized.v1 required payload keys: verified_payment_attempt_id, paid_confirmed_at_utc (plus existing payment_reference) to support TKT issuance correctness.
Persist payment verification linkage on Order: verified_payment_attempt_id, paid_confirmed_at_utc; enforce null/non-null invariants by status.

Tighten PAY verification wording: finalize_checkout MUST verify payment_reference and derive verified_payment_attempt_id + paid_confirmed_at_utc from PAY-1, rejecting non-final money states via ERR-1 subcodes ORD_PAYMENT_REQUIRED / ORD_PAYMENT_STATE_INVALID.
Bump dependency floors: ERR-1 -> 1.4.0; EVT-2 -> 2.2.0 for scan-policy/occurrence alignment compatibility.

notes: Removed multi-event prohibition; Orders may bind holds across multiple events within the same org.
Order now snapshots event_ids (array) instead of single event_id; occurrence_ids remains union.
Added checkout_group_id (uuid_v7) as a first-class grouping identifier; at most one Order per (checkout_group_id, org_id).

Added create_checkout_group / finalize_checkout_group / expire_checkout_group actions (platform-capability gated) to support one-checkout multi-org carts, producing per-org Orders that emit ticketing.order.finalized.v1 per org.
Normalized payment linkage: verified_payment_attempt_id is UUIDv7, and Order persists currency + total_amount_minor derived from PRICE snapshot.
change_log.summary: Enable multi-event Orders within a single org, add checkout_group_id for multi-org grouping, and introduce checkout-group actions for cross-org carts while preserving per-org finalization boundary.

must_verify: at create_checkout, status is active and the quote has not expired
at finalization, status is consumed and consumed_by_order_id equals this Order
signature_hash matches the declared signature version
PAY-1 verification MUST be bound to the same order_id being finalized and MUST return payment_intent_id for storage (ND-195).

constraints.rule: (status != 'finalized') OR (ledger_posting_id IS NOT NULL AND ledger_intent_id IS NOT NULL AND ledger_template_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.notes: ND-195: finalized orders MUST carry the payment_intent_id returned by PAY-1 verification.

immutability.rule: Order records MUST be immutable with respect to seat_hold_ids, bucket_hold_ids, line_items including every line_items[].inventory_claims entry, price_snapshot_id, price_signature_hash, currency, and total_amount_minor. A checkout retry MUST NOT replace a bound seat or bucket hold. Any change requires a new Order or a separately governed compensating path; these snapshots MUST NOT be mutated in place.

entitlement_context.notes: Present only when PRICE snapshot includes entitlement context.

pricing_line_key.notes: From PRICE-1 signed snapshot; binds unit pricing + eligibility context.

product_ref.notes: Product/ticket type reference; stable within org.

seat_ids.notes: Assigned seating only; omit for GA lines.

line_item_id.notes: Authoritative stable identifier for this line item within the order. MUST be generated server-side and persisted in the order snapshot; MUST NOT be UI-derived.

inventory_claims.notes: Each claim is derived from a verified SEAT-1 proof; GA claims carry bucket_id and quantity and never contain a fabricated seat_id.

required_attributes.name: line_items
required_attributes.notes: Elements MUST conform to this items schema.

required_attributes.name: finalized_at_utc
required_attributes.notes: MUST be set using database clock (ND-170), not application clock.

required_attributes.name: fee_total_minor
required_attributes.notes: Total fees in M_u scaled integer (see SUITE ND-120..ND-122). Defaults to 0.

required_attributes.name: subtotal_amount_minor
required_attributes.notes: Subtotal (pre-tax, pre-fee) in M_u scaled integer. MUST be derived from immutable pricing snapshot used at checkout creation.

required_attributes.name: tax_total_minor
required_attributes.notes: Total tax amount in M_u scaled integer. MUST be locked at checkout creation (ND-171).

required_attributes.name: tax_apportionment_priority_map
required_attributes.notes: Immutable sale-time remainder distribution priority order for taxable line items. This array MUST list line_item_id values in the exact order in which remainder minor units are allocated under TAX-1 apportionment policy. MUST be persisted at order finalization and MUST NOT be re-derived at refund time.

required_attributes.name: tax_apportionment_priority_map_sha256
required_attributes.notes: sha256 hex of canonical apportionment priority map transcript. MUST be computed as sha256(UTF8('ORD-TAX-APP-V1|' + org_id + '|' + join(line_item_id,'|'))). Used as REFUND-1 handshake anchor.

required_attributes.name: internal_rounding_adjustment_minor
required_attributes.notes: Signed M_u scaled integer capturing rounding drift so that subtotal + tax + fees + adjustment == total (ND-172). Defaults to 0.

required_attributes.name: tax_context_digest
required_attributes.notes: SHA-256 hex digest representing locked tax jurisdiction/rates/inclusivity context at checkout creation (ND-171).

required_attributes.name: locked_tax_inclusivity_mode
required_attributes.notes: Locked tax inclusivity mode at checkout creation. Allowed: 'inclusive' | 'exclusive' (ND-171).

required_attributes.name: locked_at_utc
required_attributes.notes: DB-monotonic timestamp captured at checkout creation when tax/pricing context is locked (ND-170, ND-171).

required_attributes.name: jurisdiction_evidence_ref
required_attributes.notes: Reference to evidence stored in PII-1 vault used to determine jurisdiction at lock time. Required for audit traceability.

required_attributes.name: payment_intent_id
required_attributes.notes: Set only during finalize_checkout when PAY-1 confirms PAID; MUST be immutable after set.

required_attributes.name: bucket_hold_ids
required_attributes.notes: Authoritative GA InventoryBucketHold ids returned by SEAT-1.verify_bucket_hold_proofs; empty when no bucket claims exist.

idempotency.transport_mapping: HTTP Idempotency-Key header maps to action input; not normative

beneficiary_customer_id.notes: Customer who will consume the entitlement (and must match PRICE snapshot beneficiary_customer_id for subscriber-priced lines).

entitlement_grant_id.notes: Required when entitlement_kind="subscriber"; MUST be null when entitlement_kind="none".

entitlement_kind.notes: Explicitly declares whether these units are subscriber-priced or non-entitled.

entitlement_tier_id.notes: Required when entitlement_kind="subscriber"; MUST be null when entitlement_kind="none".

line_key.notes: Stable identifier linking to the signed priced line item. Default construction: "<item_ref_type>:<item_ref_id>" for the corresponding PRICE line.

qty.notes: Number of units in the referenced line assigned to this entitlement context.

entitlement_allocations.notes: When provided, entitlement_allocations MUST reconcile exactly with signed PRICE snapshot lines. For each line_key, sum(qty) must equal line.quantity. Mixed entitlement_kind within a single line_key is not supported; split holds/lines if mixed pricing is required.

create_checkout.purpose: Create a draft Order bound to verified seat and/or GA bucket inventory claims and the exact active PRICE-1 quote snapshot.
validation_rules: pricing_snapshot_id MUST be the exact transaction-specific quote snapshot returned by OFFER-1.build_cart_quote. ORD MUST verify that this PRICE-1 snapshot belongs to org_id, is active and unexpired, has signature_version=PRICE-SIG-V4, and passes PRICE-1 signature and total validation.

Persist the supplied pricing_snapshot_id only as Order.price_snapshot_id. Order.price_snapshot_id MUST equal inputs.pricing_snapshot_id; Order MUST NOT persist or return a second authoritative pricing_snapshot_id field.

After the Order id is fixed, ORD MUST invoke PRICE-1.consume_snapshot for that exact snapshot with consumed_by_order_id=order_id. PRICE-1 owns the transition and field write; ORD MUST NOT mutate consumed_by_order_id directly. Snapshot consumption and Order creation MUST commit or roll back together, and a snapshot already consumed by another Order MUST fail closed.
Order MUST be created with status=draft
Client totals MUST be rejected or ignored

Server MUST enforce addon dependency: if any resolved EVT-2 Occurrence has workshops_require_primary_access=true, then the checkout MUST also include at least one Occurrence with occurrence_kind=main for the same event_id; otherwise return ERR_PRECONDITION subcode ORD_PRIMARY_ACCESS_REQUIRED.

Exception: an EVT-2 Occurrence with workshops_require_primary_access=true MAY be purchased without a main Occurrence ONLY if that Occurrence has standalone_allowed=true; otherwise ORD_PRIMARY_ACCESS_REQUIRED applies.
If entitlement_allocations are provided, each allocation MUST reference a hold_id present in the verified seat_hold_proofs or bucket_hold_proofs (1 allocation per hold_id max; duplicates forbidden).
entitlement_allocations MUST be treated as purchase-time intent only; raw external membership references MUST NOT be persisted (persist only non-reversible hashes or resolved subject_customer_id).
The accepted OFFER-1 quote snapshot MUST use PRICE-SIG-V4. ORD verifies the supplied snapshot; it MUST NOT create or request another snapshot.

If entitlement_allocations is provided, ORD MUST evaluate each allocation via SUB-1 at checkout creation time to prevent quoting subscriber pricing to ineligible buyers. If any allocation is ineligible, return ERR_FORBIDDEN with one of: SUB_ENTITLEMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE, SUB_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED, SUB_INVALID_STATE, SUB_GRACE_PERIOD_ELAPSED, SUB_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, SUB_OFFER_NOT_AVAILABLE, SUB_FORBIDDEN.

Mixed subscriber and non-subscriber pricing within a single multi-unit inventory hold is NOT supported in ORD-1 v3.0.11. To purchase (e.g.) 2 subscriber units + 2 normal units from the same GA pool, the client MUST split into separate holds in SEAT-1 so each hold has a uniform pricing context, then provide entitlement_allocations per hold.

If any subscriber entitlement is applied (i.e., any resulting PRICE line has entitlement_grant_id present), ORD MUST NOT accept PRICE-SIG-V1/V2 snapshots for that checkout; PRICE-SIG-V3 or PRICE-SIG-V4 is required (PRICE-SIG-V4 preferred for new checkouts).
Implementations MUST derive line_items by combining: verified holds (SEAT-1) + signed pricing lines (PRICE-1). line_items MUST be immutable once persisted.
Implementations MUST derive event_ids and occurrence_ids from line_items as sorted de-duplicated unions. Client-provided event_ids/occurrence_ids are ignored.

Addon dependency checks MUST be evaluated per event_id: for each event_id in event_ids, if any bound occurrence requires primary access, the corresponding primary occurrence MUST be present within the same order for that event_id unless the occurrence is explicitly marked as standalone in EVT-2/SEAT-1 metadata.
Implementation MUST secure payment-grace hold extensions via SEAT-1 per ORD-1-GC-001-SD-043-001 before returning checkout_url / payment initiation tokens.

Tax lock: create_checkout MUST resolve jurisdiction evidence (PII-1 vault) and compute TAX-1 tax_context_digest + locked_tax_inclusivity_mode. It MUST persist Order.tax_context_digest, Order.locked_tax_inclusivity_mode, Order.jurisdiction_evidence_ref, and Order.locked_at_utc (DB time) and these fields MUST be immutable thereafter. (ND-170, ND-171)

Money arithmetic: create_checkout MUST persist subtotal_amount_minor, tax_total_minor, fee_total_minor, internal_rounding_adjustment_minor, and total_amount_minor as M_u scaled integers. It MUST enforce: subtotal + tax + fees + adjustment == total. (ND-172)
At least one of seat_hold_proofs or bucket_hold_proofs MUST contain a verified proof. Empty combined proof sets MUST fail closed.
When seat_hold_proofs are supplied, preserve current SEAT-1.verify_hold_proofs validation and persist authoritative seat_hold_ids.
When bucket_hold_proofs are supplied, call SEAT-1.verify_bucket_hold_proofs and persist authoritative bucket_hold_ids; never resolve bucket holds by id alone.
Derive event_ids and occurrence_ids only from verified seat and bucket tuples and deduplicate in stable order.

Every line item MUST bind to verified inventory_claims. A bucket claim MUST match the verified occurrence_id, bucket_id and quantity exactly. Bucket-backed lines MUST omit seat_ids and MUST NOT invent a seat_id.
Checkout expiry MUST be min(database_now + 15 minutes, active PRICE quote expiry, every bound seat hold expiry, every bound bucket hold expiry).

Before returning checkout handoff data, call SEAT-1.extend_hold_grace for every seat proof and SEAT-1.extend_bucket_hold_grace for every bucket proof using the existing SEAT-1 limits; then compute expiry from updated authoritative expiries.

Single-order create_checkout emits no checkout-created domain event unless a registered EVT-1 event type and this action producer law explicitly require it. Do not emit ticketing.order.checkout_created.v1 based on checkout-group text alone.
Order.expires_at_utc MUST equal the bounded minimum of checkout TTL, active quote expiry, and all extended hold expiries.
ORD MUST NOT silently create a different snapshot during checkout after accepting a quote; it MUST bind the supplied pricing_snapshot_id or fail closed.
Every verified seat or bucket hold MUST bind to exactly one persisted line_items[].inventory_claims entry; no verified proof may be left unbound and no line claim may lack a verified proof.
ORD MUST NOT create or request another snapshot after accepting an OFFER-1 quote; it verifies and consumes only the supplied snapshot.

seat_and_bucket_proof_rule.sets: Each supplied non-empty proof set MUST be verified independently. A bucket-only Order is valid without seat proofs; a seat-only Order is valid without bucket proofs; mixed claims require both sets.
seat_and_bucket_proof_rule.invalid_behavior: Missing, extra, changed, expired, wrong-tenant, wrong-actor, wrong-bucket, or wrong-quantity proof fails closed.

event_emission.reason: EVT-1 does not register ticketing.order.checkout_created.v1 and single-order create_checkout has no producer law requiring a checkout-created event.

create_checkout_group.purpose: Create a multi-org checkout group (platform-orchestrated) from seat_hold_proofs, producing one draft org-scoped Order per target org derived from verified holds. All created Orders share the same checkout_group_id.
side_effects: Calls PRICE-1.create_snapshot per org partition (until PRICE supports cross-org snapshots).
Persists Orders and enqueues ticketing.order.checkout_created.v1 after commit (per order).
validation_rules: This action is cross-tenant orchestration and MUST be allowed only for platform/system services with explicit capability. The input org_id denotes the operator context only and MUST NOT be used as the target org partition.

Implementations MUST partition verified holds by org_id and create exactly one draft Order per org_id, each with its own seat_hold_ids, line_items, price_snapshot_id, price_signature_hash, signature_hash, currency, and total_amount_minor.
All created Orders MUST share checkout_group_id and actor_id. All created Orders MUST share the same expires_at_utc equal to the minimum expires_at_utc across the created Orders.
If any org partition fails validation, the entire action MUST fail and MUST NOT create partial Orders.

Implementations MUST validate that every derived Order.currency equals inputs.currency. If any org partition yields a different currency, the entire orchestration MUST fail with ERR_VALIDATION subcode ORD_CHECKOUT_GROUP_CURRENCY_MISMATCH and MUST NOT create any Orders.
Implementation MUST secure payment-grace hold extensions via SEAT-1 per ORD-1-GC-001-SD-043-001 before returning checkout_url / payment initiation tokens.

expire_checkout.purpose: Expire draft orders whose TTL has elapsed and release associated holds.
validation_rules: now() MUST be > order.expires_at_utc
status MUST transition draft → expired

ORD-1 does not own hold release. Holds MUST expire/release by SEAT-1 TTL enforcement. expire_checkout MUST mark the Order expired (status=expired, expired_at_utc set) and MUST emit ticketing.order.expired.v1 after commit.
expire_checkout MUST set expired_at_utc and transition status to 'expired' only when status=='draft'.

expire_checkout_group.purpose: Expire all draft org-scoped Orders in a checkout_group_id (platform-orchestrated).
side_effects: Transitions each Order to status='expired' and sets expired_at_utc for each order.
Enqueues ticketing.order.expired.v1 per order after commit.
validation_rules: This action is cross-tenant orchestration and MUST be allowed only for platform/system services with explicit capability. The input org_id denotes the operator context only and MUST NOT be used as the target org partition.
All Orders in the group MUST share the same actor_id. Orders that are already finalized MUST NOT be expired.
If any Order cannot be expired, the action MUST fail and MUST NOT partially expire the group.

idempotency.transport_mapping: HTTP Idempotency-Key header maps to action input; not normative

finalize_checkout.ledger_intent: - Platform fees MUST be derived from PAY-3 FeeAssessment (SD-011) and MUST NOT be inserted ad-hoc (ORD_PLATFORM_FEE_DERIVATION_FORBIDDEN).
postconditions: OrderFeeLine rows MUST be written from the PAY-3 FeeAssessment fee_lines (if present) and Order.fee_total_minor MUST reconcile to them.
If PricingSnapshot.platform_fee_mode='on' AND platform_fee_payer_mode='buyer', PricingSnapshot MUST include the PLATFORM_FEE PriceLine and it MUST reconcile to OrderFeeLine totals.
preconditions: A PAY-3 FeeAssessment MUST be computed for this org-scope order using a resolved FeeScheduleRevision (or fees must be explicitly disabled).
finalize_checkout.purpose: Finalize the checkout as a single atomic commit.
validation_rules: now() MUST be < order.expires_at_utc
status MUST be draft prior to finalization

Given `payment_reference`, the system MUST call PAY-1.verify_payment_reference with `expected_order_id = order_id` and `org_id`. Finalization MUST fail-closed unless PAY-1 returns a Provider-verified outcome where `resolved_order_id == order_id`.

If PAY-1 outcome is Provider-verified PAID, ORD-1 MUST persist `payment_intent_id` (from PAY-1), `verified_payment_attempt_id` (or equivalent provider attempt id), and `paid_confirmed_at_utc = provider_confirmed_at_utc` in the Order record. These fields MUST be immutable after finalization.
PRICE-1 signature_hash MUST be verified as a DB predicate in the atomic commit (no client-trust).

ORD MUST NOT construct raw ledger legs. finalize_checkout MUST construct a canonical LED-1 Posting Intent payload using template_id='SALE_STD' (or another allowlisted template) with args derived strictly from the verified PRICE snapshot (unit totals, platform fee, tax amounts) and TAX-1 policy (tax_inclusion_mode). finalize_checkout MUST call LED-1.post_intent(payload, idempotency_key, idempotency_payload_hash_sha256) inside the same DB transaction. The idempotency_key passed to LED-1 MUST be derived from order_id (e.g., 'ord_finalize:' + order_id) and MUST be unique per finalized order. ORD MUST persist ledger_intent_id, ledger_posting_id, ledger_template_id, ledger_idempotency_key, and ledger_idempotency_payload_hash_sha256 on the Order row in the same transaction.
Concurrent finalize attempts MUST be rejected via optimistic locking

ORD MUST validate the PRICE snapshot signature using the declared price_signature_version; implementations MUST support PRICE-SIG-V1/V2/V3/V4 for legacy checkouts and MUST require PRICE-SIG-V4 for new checkouts.

If any PRICE line in the snapshot carries entitlement_grant_id (subscriber pricing), ORD MUST re-evaluate entitlement eligibility at purchase-finalize time via SUB-1 for the relevant subject/beneficiary and MUST reject finalize if ineligible (use SUB_* subcodes).

Subscriber-priced lines MAY be mixed with non-subscriber lines in the same order; entitlement enforcement MUST occur per line (beneficiary-aware) and quota rules MUST be enforced (use SUB_QUOTA_EXCEEDED when applicable).

Implementations MUST re-derive event_ids/occurrence_ids from persisted line_items and MUST enforce addon dependency rules per event_id prior to seat allocation; any violation MUST fail with ERR_PRECONDITION ORD_PRIMARY_ACCESS_REQUIRED or ORD_ADDON_DEPENDENCY_MISSING as applicable.

If payment confirmation arrives after order.expires_at_utc or holds have expired, finalize_checkout MUST fail deterministically and the payment pipeline MUST execute PAY-3 compensation (void/refund) with ERR-1 subcode PAY_LATE_CAPTURE_AFTER_HOLD_EXPIRED (no issuance).

Tax lock enforcement: finalize_checkout MUST compute the current tax_context_digest (TAX-1) for the same jurisdiction evidence and fail-closed if it differs from Order.tax_context_digest. No tax recomputation is allowed for a locked intent. (ND-171)
DB temporal truth: finalize_checkout MUST set finalized_at_utc using the database clock inside the finalization transaction. (ND-170)
Audit evidence binding: finalize_checkout MUST include jurisdiction_evidence_ref in the ledger intent payload and MUST NOT allow it to be modified during retry/recovery flows. (PII-1 ↔ TAX-1 ↔ ORD-1)

At least one persisted bound hold set MUST be non-empty. For each non-empty Order.seat_hold_ids or Order.bucket_hold_ids set, the corresponding proof input is required and its verified set MUST match exactly; mixed Orders require both. Missing, extra, or changed proofs fail closed.
Re-verify each required proof set at commit time against its exact persisted Order hold-ID set. Any missing, extra, or changed proof fails closed.
For bucket holds call SEAT-1.verify_bucket_hold_proofs and allocate each via SEAT-1.allocate_bucket_hold inside the same atomic finalization boundary.
For seat holds preserve existing verify_hold_proofs and seat allocation behavior.
All bound holds MUST be unexpired at commit time.
Bucket allocations MUST match persisted order line occurrence_id, bucket_id and quantity; no seat_id is synthesized.

SEAT-1 seat allocations, SEAT-1 bucket allocations, Order status transition, and the existing ledger writes MUST remain in the same Postgres transaction; any allocation failure rolls back the finalization.

bound_hold_proof_rule.mixed_order: Both proof inputs are required and each verified set MUST equal its persisted Order set exactly.
bound_hold_proof_rule.invalid_behavior: Missing, extra, or changed proof fails closed; each supplied proof is reverified at commit time.

finalize_checkout_group.purpose: Finalize all draft org-scoped Orders in a checkout_group_id (platform-orchestrated) using a single payment_reference. Emits ticketing.order.finalized.v1 per order after commit.
side_effects: Allocates seats via SEAT-1 for each Order partition.
Posts LED-1 entries per org partition.
Enqueues ticketing.order.finalized.v1 events after commit (per order).
validation_rules: This action is cross-tenant orchestration and MUST be allowed only for platform/system services with explicit capability. The input org_id denotes the operator context only and MUST NOT be used as the target org partition.
Implementations MUST load all Orders sharing checkout_group_id and MUST ensure they all share the same actor_id and are in status=='draft'.

Implementations MUST verify payment_reference via PAY-* and MUST validate: (1) all Orders in the checkout_group_id share the same Order.currency, (2) verified payment currency equals that group currency, and (3) verified payment amount equals the sum of Order.total_amount_minor across the group. If currencies are mixed or mismatched, finalize_checkout_group MUST fail with ERR_VALIDATION subcode ORD_CHECKOUT_GROUP_CURRENCY_MISMATCH.
Implementations MUST finalize every Order in the group atomically at the database level. Partial finalization is forbidden.
verified_payment_attempt_id and paid_confirmed_at_utc MUST be persisted onto each finalized Order.

If payment confirmation arrives after order.expires_at_utc or holds have expired, finalize_checkout_group MUST fail deterministically and the payment pipeline MUST execute PAY-3 compensation (void/refund) with ERR-1 subcode PAY_LATE_CAPTURE_AFTER_HOLD_EXPIRED (no issuance).

For multi-order checkout groups, payment verification MUST be performed via a group-capable payment contract (PAY-4) that binds the provider payment reference to `checkout_group_id` and returns the exact set of `order_id`s. Using PAY-1 (order-bound) for group verification is forbidden.

ORD_ENTITLEMENT_ALLOCATION_INVALID.notes: Invalid entitlement_allocations schema or invariant violation.

ORD_ENTITLEMENT_ALLOCATION_QTY_MISMATCH.notes: Allocation quantities do not reconcile with signed priced line quantities.

subcodes.ORD_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: Payment is required to finalize; payment_reference missing; MUST map to ERR-1 registry subcode.
subcodes.ORD_PAYMENT_STATE_INVALID: Payment is missing or not in a final verified state for order finalization; MUST map to ERR-1 registry subcode.
subcodes.ORD_PRIMARY_ACCESS_REQUIRED: Addon/session/workshop items require primary access for this event.
subcodes.SUB_ENTITLEMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Subscriber entitlement is not eligible at purchase-finalize time (status/tier/org mismatch).
subcodes.SUB_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED: Subscriber entitlement is required to purchase this offer/price.
subcodes.SUB_GRACE_PERIOD_ELAPSED: Subscriber entitlement grace period has elapsed; not eligible for subscriber pricing.
subcodes.SUB_INVALID_STATE: Subscriber entitlement is in an invalid state for purchase.
subcodes.SUB_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Subscriber quota exceeded for this event/offer.
subcodes.SUB_SUBJECT_MISMATCH: Subscriber entitlement subject does not match the beneficiary/customer context.

GC-001.notes: Extend holds for grace at checkout creation; reject/fail finalization if expired; auto-void/refund on late capture.

idempotency_hash_spec.notes: For cross-tenant checkout-group actions, org_id is the anchor org_id supplied for audit; actor_id binds idempotency across org partitions.

invariants.text: At checkout creation (create_checkout / create_checkout_group), the platform MUST request SEAT-1 to extend every hold bound to the order so that hold.expires_at_utc >= order.expires_at_utc + payment_grace_seconds_default. Extension MUST be idempotent and bounded by SEAT-1 policies. If extension cannot be secured, checkout creation MUST fail (no payment initiation).

If a payment is confirmed by the provider AFTER the Order is terminal (expired/canceled) or after seat/inventory holds have expired, ORD-1 MUST NOT finalize the Order. The system MUST emit an `audit_recovery` signal into OBS-1 (ND-196) with correlation ids and the provider evidence, and MUST route the funds for deterministic disposition (refund or unallocated credit journaling) per PAY-3/REFUND-1. This is a fail-closed posture.

The finalize_checkout action MUST NOT accept fee_lines or fee_total_minor as input arguments. These fields MUST be computed exclusively by the system via the fetch_platform_fees step. Client-side fee injection is strictly forbidden.

Implementations MUST NOT accept client-provided totals (total_amount_minor, line totals, taxes). Totals MUST be derived server-side from a PRICE-1 price_snapshot and verified via price_signature_hash and signature_hash.

Every draft Order MUST set expires_at_utc to min(database_now + checkout TTL, the accepted quote snapshot expiry, each bound seat hold expiry, and each bound bucket hold expiry), using the authoritative hold expiries after bounded SEAT-1 grace is secured. Empty seat or bucket sets contribute no expiry. finalize_checkout MUST fail after expires_at_utc with ERR_PRECONDITION subcode ORD_CHECKOUT_EXPIRED.

finalize_checkout MUST be atomic at the database level: either the Order is finalized, every inventory claim bound to the Order is allocated using its matching SEAT-1 seat or bucket allocation action, and ledger postings are recorded together, OR none of those effects occur.
finalize_checkout MUST enforce optimistic locking using Order.version. Concurrent finalization attempts MUST return ERR_CONFLICT with subcode LOCKS_OPTIMISTIC_CONFLICT.
Outbox events MUST be emitted after commit only (after_commit_only). Finalized events MUST include actor_id, payment_reference, verified_payment_attempt_id, and paid_confirmed_at_utc.

For single-order create_checkout/finalize_checkout, verify every supplied proof through its matching SEAT-1 action and persist only authoritative hold IDs. At finalization, if Order.seat_hold_ids is non-empty, seat_hold_proofs are required and their verified set MUST equal Order.seat_hold_ids exactly; if Order.bucket_hold_ids is non-empty, bucket_hold_proofs are required and their verified set MUST equal Order.bucket_hold_ids exactly. At least one persisted set MUST be non-empty. Bucket-only Orders do not require seat proofs; seat-only Orders do not require bucket proofs. Mixed Orders require both exact proof sets. Missing, extra, or changed proofs MUST fail closed with the matching canonical proof error. The existing checkout-group actions retain their separately declared seat-only inputs in this version.

If status == 'finalized', finalized_at_utc MUST be non-null AND payment_reference MUST be non-null AND verified_payment_attempt_id MUST be non-null AND paid_confirmed_at_utc MUST be non-null. If status == 'expired', expired_at_utc MUST be non-null. If status == 'cancelled', cancelled_at_utc MUST be non-null. If status == 'draft', finalized_at_utc/expired_at_utc/cancelled_at_utc MUST all be null AND payment_reference/verified_payment_attempt_id/paid_confirmed_at_utc MUST all be null.

Implementations MUST resolve seat_hold_proofs by calling SEAT-1.verify_hold_proofs. Implementations MUST NOT derive occurrence_id/seat_id by fetching holds via hold_id alone (ID-only trust is forbidden).

Order.line_items MUST be the canonical snapshot of purchasable units and MUST bind to PRICE-signed lines (pricing_line_key). event_ids/occurrence_ids MUST be derived from line_items and MUST NOT be client-authoritative.

Multi-org checkouts MUST be represented as one Order per target org_id sharing the same checkout_group_id. All Orders in a checkout_group_id MUST share the same actor_id. create_checkout_group / finalize_checkout_group / expire_checkout_group are cross-tenant orchestration actions and MUST be platform/system-owned operations requiring explicit capability. For these orchestration actions, the input org_id denotes the operator context only and MUST NOT be used as the target org partition. Target org partitions MUST be derived from verified SEAT hold partitioning. finalize_checkout_group MUST validate that payment_reference matches the group total and MUST finalize each Order exactly-once.

For new single-order checkouts, OFFER-1 MUST provide an active, unexpired PRICE-SIG-V4 quote snapshot. ORD MUST verify and bind that exact snapshot, then invoke PRICE-1.consume_snapshot for the Order. ORD MUST NOT request or create a replacement snapshot. ORD MUST continue to verify PRICE-SIG-V3 for legacy checkouts.

Checkout group orchestration MUST be executed under a platform/service authority boundary (not an organizer tenant boundary). Implementations MUST perform any cross-tenant reads/writes using audited capability-gated access and MUST still enforce actor_id authorization per target org partition. If any target org partition fails validation or persistence, the entire orchestration MUST fail and MUST NOT create or finalize partial Orders.

All Orders in the same checkout_group_id MUST share the same currency. create_checkout_group MUST fail-closed if any derived org partition would yield an Order.currency differing from inputs.currency. finalize_checkout_group MUST fail-closed if Orders in the group have mixed currencies or if verified payment currency does not equal the group's currency. Violations MUST return ERR_VALIDATION subcode ORD_CHECKOUT_GROUP_CURRENCY_MISMATCH. No FX inference is permitted.
Order.fee_total_minor MUST equal the sum over OrderFeeLine (amount_minor + tax_amount_minor).
Platform fees MUST be derived from PAY-3 FeeAssessment/FeeScheduleRevision; ad-hoc insertion is forbidden (ORD_PLATFORM_FEE_DERIVATION_FORBIDDEN).
If PricingSnapshot.platform_fee_mode='on' AND platform_fee_payer_mode='buyer', PricingSnapshot MUST include the PLATFORM_FEE PriceLine and OrderFeeLine MUST reconcile to that line total.

Order tax context MUST be locked at checkout creation. Order.tax_context_digest, Order.locked_tax_inclusivity_mode, Order.jurisdiction_evidence_ref, and Order.locked_at_utc MUST be persisted at create_checkout and MUST NOT change thereafter. finalize_checkout MUST fail-closed if the current computed tax_context_digest (from TAX-1 using the same evidence ref) does not exactly match Order.tax_context_digest (ND-171).

Order totals MUST be internally balanced in M_u scaled integers: subtotal_amount_minor + tax_total_minor + fee_total_minor + internal_rounding_adjustment_minor MUST equal total_amount_minor for every Order row (ND-172).

All financial finalization timestamps MUST be sourced from the database clock (Postgres) as the single temporal source of truth. finalized_at_utc MUST be set using a DB-side now() predicate within the finalization transaction (ND-170).

On successful finalization, ORD-1 MUST persist `payment_intent_id` returned by PAY-1 and MUST treat it as immutable. Any subsequent reconciliation MUST treat `(order_id, payment_intent_id)` as the authoritative binding for payment outcomes for this order.

At order finalization, the system MUST compute and persist tax_apportionment_priority_map as an immutable, authoritative ordering of taxable line_item_id values. All downstream refunds MUST consume this map to allocate remainder minor units deterministically. The map MUST NOT be UI-derived and MUST NOT be recomputed at refund time.

invariants.must: Order.bucket_hold_ids MUST equal the unique authoritative InventoryBucketHold ids returned by SEAT-1.verify_bucket_hold_proofs. Each bucket-backed line item MUST bind exact verified occurrence_id, bucket_id and quantity. No bucket claim may be represented as a SeatHold or fabricated seat_id.

bulkhead_routing.enforcement: Implementation MUST execute actions in the mapped DP-1 pool, either via Repo wrappers, Oban queue->Repo pool mapping, or explicit pool selection in data layer.
bulkhead_routing.principle: Checkout flow MUST not share DB pool with expiry/sweep workloads. Expiry is best-effort background work and MUST be bulkheaded away from revenue path.

data_backfills: If upgrading from utc_datetime to utc_datetime_usec fields, backfill microseconds as 0 for historical records and regenerate indexes.
rolling_deploy_safety: During rolling deploy, finalize_checkout MUST remain idempotent across N and N-1 service versions.
Existing draft orders MAY expire naturally at original expires_at_utc; do not extend TTL implicitly.

runbooks.note: Runbook MUST exist in OBS-1 runbook registry (external to this bundle).

owns: Order state machine (draft, finalized, expired, cancelled)
Authoritative binding between Order and PRICE-1 price_snapshot + signature_hash
Support multi-event Orders within a single org and checkout_group_id grouping for multi-org carts.

notes: ORD-1 itself does not resolve disputes; dispute lifecycle is owned by PAY-3.

However, ORD-1 downstream admin operations that mutate fulfillment/issuance (e.g., manual seat reassign, ticket reissue triggers, forced cancellation) MUST treat active_dispute as a risk flag and MUST fail closed unless an explicit admin override pathway exists with auditable evidence.
When dispute_active, admin override paths SHOULD be blocked by default (ERR-1 GOV_ADMIN_OVERRIDE_BLOCKED_DISPUTE_ACTIVE).

rules.text: Finalization MUST be a single Postgres transaction that (a) transitions the Order to status=finalized, (b) allocates every bound seat claim with SEAT-1.allocate_hold and every bound bucket claim with SEAT-1.allocate_bucket_hold using exact verified proofs, and (c) submits a ledger posting intent via LED-1.post_intent using an allowlisted template (default: SALE_STD) derived from the verified PRICE snapshot + TAX policy. Any failure MUST roll back every allocation, Order transition, and ledger write. Cross-service sagas/workflows are forbidden for finalization.

Order finalization MUST represent money-confirmed only. Implementations MUST NOT finalize for any non-final money state. Proof is verified_payment_attempt_id + paid_confirmed_at_utc obtained by verifying payment_reference against PAY-* contracts.

Order.line_items MUST be the canonical immutable price-and-inventory snapshot and MUST bind each purchasable unit to PRICE-signed lines and verified inventory_claims. Each element MUST include line_item_id, line_key (unique within Order), event_id, occurrence_id, product_ref, qty >= 1, pricing_line_key, and inventory_claims. Assigned-seat claims MAY include seat_ids. GA bucket claims MUST include bucket_id and quantity and MUST omit seat_ids. event_ids and occurrence_ids MUST be derived from verified inventory-bound line_items and MUST NOT be client-authoritative.

Order.event_ids and Order.occurrence_ids MUST equal the de-duplicated, sorted unions of line_items[].event_id and line_items[].occurrence_id respectively. Implementations MUST NOT accept client-provided event_ids/occurrence_ids that diverge from line_items.

Orders MAY include holds/lines spanning multiple events within the same org_id. Any policy constraints (e.g., addon dependency rules) MUST be evaluated per event_id and MUST NOT rely on a single Order.event_id field.

checkout_group_id is a first-class grouping identifier. Multi-org carts MUST be represented as one Order per org_id sharing the same checkout_group_id. finalize_checkout_group MUST finalize all Orders in the group using a single payment_reference and MUST enforce actor_id equality across the group.

Outbox events MUST be enqueued after the database commit only (after_commit_only). ticketing.order.finalized.v1 MUST include verified_payment_attempt_id and paid_confirmed_at_utc; omission is forbidden.

ORD-1.finalize_checkout MUST fail-closed unless PAY-1.verify_payment_reference returns provider-verified PAID AND `resolved_order_id` equals the ORD-1 `order_id` being finalized. The returned `payment_intent_id` MUST be stored and treated immutable.

create_checkout MUST accept seat_hold_proofs plus bucket_hold_proofs, require at least one valid proof overall, preserve seat verification, and verify GA proofs through SEAT-1.verify_bucket_hold_proofs. Order occurrence_ids MUST come only from verified tuples. Checkout expiry MUST be bounded by every active hold and quote expiry. Secure grace for all bound hold types before returning checkout handoff data.

Order.bucket_hold_ids and Order.seat_hold_ids are immutable after checkout creation. Order.line_items and every line_items[].inventory_claims value are one immutable snapshot. A retry MUST NOT replace or remove a bound hold; any correction requires a separately governed new Order or compensation path.

summary:
Integrate PAY-3 Fee Engine (SD-011) and PRICE-1 Platform Fee Lines. Security hardening: forbid client-side fee injection.

3.5.4: Repin GC-001 chain to PAY-1@2.7.7 and PAY-2@2.8.4 (no semantic rule changes).
title: ORD-1 — Orders & Checkout Finalization Contract (Ticketing / Ash 3.x)

redis_postgres_atomicity.text: When finalizing an order that consumes inventory held in a volatile store (e.g., Redis), the platform MUST perform a crash-safe, idempotent handover between the volatile hold record and the durable Postgres truth. The handover MUST guarantee all of the following under retry, process crash, and network partition: (1) No Ghost Holds: after durable commitment that an inventory claim is allocated in Postgres, any corresponding volatile hold record MUST be removed or marked as terminal such that it cannot block future buyers; (2) No Double-Sell: a seat MUST NOT be committed as sold/reserved in Postgres while any competing buyer can still obtain or extend a volatile hold for that same inventory claim; (3) Deterministic Reconciliation: if the handover is interrupted, a deterministic reconciliation procedure MUST converge both stores to Postgres truth within a bounded time window, without human intervention; (4) Proof of Completion: the order finalization workflow MUST record a durable marker that the handover completed (or that reconciliation completed) so that retries do not repeat side effects. If true atomic cross-store commit is not available, the implementation MUST use an equivalent pattern such as a Postgres outbox + redis tombstone key keyed by (org_id, occurrence_id, seat_id, hold_id) with compare-and-set semantics and bounded TTL, and MUST treat Postgres as the source of truth for final allocation.

paired_inventory_finalization.atomicity: Seat allocations, bucket allocations, Order status transition, and existing ledger writes commit or roll back together under the existing verified-payment boundary.

paired_quote_binding.snapshot_lifecycle: OFFER-1 invokes PRICE-1.create_snapshot then PRICE-1.activate_snapshot. ORD-1 verifies that exact active, unexpired PRICE-SIG-V4 snapshot and invokes PRICE-1.consume_snapshot. PRICE-1 owns consumed_by_order_id.
